name: @brooswit/herdr-sdk
description: Typed TypeScript client for the herdr socket API, generated from herdr's published JSON Schema

scripts.generate: bun run scripts/gen/index.ts && bun run scripts/load/generate.ts
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --sourcemap=external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:unit: bun test test/unit test/load && bun run scripts/coverage/gate.ts
scripts.check: bun run generate && bun run typecheck && bun test test/unit test/load && bun run scripts/coverage/gate.ts && bun run scripts/verify-generated-is-committed.ts
